uspContent.title: Why you should work with me
uspContent.chatAriaLabel: Chat between a client and Moritz

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: Okay Moritz, that hits pretty close to home. But web designers are a dime a dozen — why should I work with you of all people?

messages.author: owner
messages.text: But among all that sand on the shore, there's amber too. You just have to know how to spot it.

messages.author: owner
messages.text: For a start: I'm a developer and web designer in one person. I've been working with code for around 10 years — including 3 years professionally in software development, and for about a year now with a clear focus on web design.

messages.author: owner
messages.text: Your website is built as real code instead of a site builder: fast load times, no template limits — and it grows with your business.

messages.author: owner
messages.text: You always talk directly to the person building your site. I usually reply within 24 hours — and I'm not gone after launch.

messages.author: owner
messages.text: And we talk like normal people: no developer jargon, no agency speak. If you don't need something, I'll tell you.

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: Okay, sounds good. But honestly: what's it going to cost me?

messages.author: owner
messages.text: Honest answer: it really depends. Best we sort that out in a quick 15-minute call — free and without obligation.

servicesIntentTitle: Choose your goal. You immediately see which offer fits and what the next step would be.
